### Added

- **13 new app integrations** — Lidarr, Readarr, Whisparr, SABnzbd, NZBGet, Transmission, Jackett, Tautulli, Audiobookshelf, Immich, Tdarr, Maintainerr, Frigate (filled 8-cell cards)
- **Wallpaper overlay strength** slider — Glass & Layout Parameters now tints (or clears) wallpaper on every theme; set to **0** for the clear default AMUD look
- **Theme variable contract** — all 36 bundled themes refactored; glass opacity, blur, bento radius, and overlay strength respect user sliders

### Fixed

- **Integration cards** — CPU/RAM cells always shown (`—` when host agent is off); no empty bottom row
- **Card hover removed** — no lift/glow flip on app cards; metrics stay visible
- **Bundled themes** — no hardcoded `body` wallpaper overlays or fixed `--bg-card` alpha blocking Glass & Layout sliders
- **Guest dashboard** — compact cards pack tightly; grid rows use `auto` height (no large empty gaps)

### Improved

- `theme-guards.css` enforces user glass settings after custom CSS
- Theme audit doc updated for v1.5.6.4 QA matrix
- Configuration/features docs list all new integrations

### Upgrade

```bash
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
```

Hard-refresh after upgrade (`Ctrl+Shift+R`). If you use a bundled theme, re-pick it in **Settings → Theme Gallery** once to load the updated CSS.

**Existing users:** saved `custom_css` from an older theme paste may still use pre-refactor rules — click your theme again and **Save Changes**.
